description.value: Nesters Market Yaletown is a full-service neighbourhood grocery store in Vancouver's Yaletown district, part of a BC-born chain founded in Whistler in 1987 and now operated by the Pattison Food Group. The chain built its identity around local, organic, natural, and specialty products not typically found at larger chains, and the Yaletown location — the brand's second store, opened in 2003 — sits in a dense, walkable urban neighbourhood well-positioned for urban bike tourists. In-store services include a bakery, deli and bistro, pharmacy, and health and wellness department.

Services listed on the website include Deli & Bistro, In-Store Bakery, Fresh Produce, and Natural & Organic, confirming basic groceries and supporting hot food. Neither the website nor OSM tags provide evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most other cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null.
